name: OC20
brief: Small adsorbates relaxing on catalyst surfaces drawn from 55 elements — mostly alloys and intermetallics, not pure metals. The Open Catalyst Project built three benchmark tasks and a public leaderboard around it, and much of the graph-network lineage in this catalog was trained and ranked on it.
paperTitle: Open Catalyst 2020 (OC20) Dataset and Community Challenges
primaryPaper: Chanussot et al., Open Catalyst 2020 (OC20) Dataset and Community Challenges, ACS Catal. (2021).
